description: Explicitly listed intentional gaps: JSONB operators, COPY, PL/pgSQL triggers/functions, binary protocol, malformed protocol frames, and cancel requests
cleanup_sql: DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS nm_gap_touch ON nm_gap_trigger;
sql: CREATE TABLE nm_gap_jsonb (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, doc JSONB);
SELECT doc->'a'->>'b' AS b FROM nm_gap_jsonb WHERE doc ? 'tags';
CREATE TABLE nm_gap_copy (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, label TEXT);
CREATE TABLE nm_gap_trigger (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, touched INT);
CREATE FUNCTION nm_gap_fn() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS 'BEGIN NEW.touched := 1; RETURN NEW; END';
CREATE TRIGGER nm_gap_touch BEFORE INSERT ON nm_gap_trigger FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION nm_gap_fn();
expected_difference: BicDB does not yet claim JSONB operator, COPY FROM STDIN, PL/pgSQL trigger execution, binary-format bind parity, malformed protocol frame parity, or cancel-request parity. Protocol-level gaps are also exercised by crates/bicdb-pgwire/tests/protocol.rs and scripts/pg18-nightmare.sh.
